_comment: SP-064: the image pick's rubric, read by lib/pick.js (Jev), shaped like scripts/story-rubric.json's axes. One Score question per scored cell and axis; Jev answers a level 0-2, and the axis score is that + 1 (decimals kept, as US-038 keeps them). A partly cut must-see item gets the lowest clarity.

plausible.label: Plausible
levels: the scene makes little sense: no setting clues, or the action happens in an order that doesn't fit the story
the scene makes some sense: a few setting clues, or a mostly sensible order of action
the scene makes sense: clear setting clues such as a floor, a hand or a height, and a sensible order of action

vivid.label: Vivid
levels: a flat, distant or ordinary shot at eye level
a closer shot or a somewhat unusual camera angle
an extreme close-up or a strong camera angle

clarity.label: Must-see clarity
levels: a must-see item is partly cut off by the edge of the picture, or small and hard to make out
every must-see item is shown in full, but some are small or unclear
every must-see item is shown in full, large and clear
